content:
ana: quick note from onboarding: sampleapp generator blocks on Close if you cancel during startup. saw it twice in the new-hire lab.

ryan: which sample? which sdk? can you paste a tiny repro?

ana: the Go quickstart (generator iterator). go 1.20 + go-sdk v0.14.4. snippet below. Next(ctx) returns after cancel but Close() waits for auth/handshake retries and tests hang.

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()

client := redwood.NewClient(apiKey)
g := client.Generator("gpt-open")
for g.Next(ctx) { fmt.Println(g.Value().Text) }
// calling Close here blocks until ctx deadline
if err := g.Close(); err != nil { log.Printf("close: %v", err) }
```

ryan: ugh. I hit this in CI when the fake token server returns intermittent 500s. pprof shows goroutines stuck in token refresh backoff.

sophia: two quick UX fixes: (1) SDK exposes CloseWithTimeout(d time.Duration) or Close(ctx) so test harnesses can bound shutdown; (2) update the quickstart to show passing a ctx into the ctor (NewGenerator(ctx,...)) as a recommended pattern.

ana: closing with a timeout would solve CI flakes immediately. long term, we should ensure token refresh honors cancellation so the handshake isn't indefinitely stuck.

ryan: implementation note: prefer adding Close(ctx) with a non-breaking Close() wrapper that uses background + default timeout to preserve behavior. Also add a WithHandshakeCtx(ctx) option for explicit control.

sophia: agree. runtime change: token source/backoff loops must select on ctx.Done() between attempts. I can add a test that injects a slow token provider and assert Close(ctx) returns quickly when ctx cancelled.

infra-bot: created task DE-3999: "go-sdk: generator Close blocks when auth handshake retries; add Close(ctx) + WithHandshakeCtx and make token refresh cancelable" -> https://tracker/internal/DE-3999

ana: i'm adding a tiny failing unit to the sampleapp repo so new hires can reproduce locally: https://gist.github.com/ana/generator-cancel-repro

ryan: for docs/devex: add a one-paragraph troubleshooting item in quickstart: "If your app cancels contexts during startup or your auth provider retries, prefer passing a handshake ctx or use Close(ctx) to bound shutdown." Also show both iterator and callback patterns.

sophia: will draft the SDK PR with Close(ctx) + WithHandshakeCtx and tests. devex can patch quickstart once it lands.

ana: thanks — marking this onboarding-blocker. will ping if I hit anything else while triaging the failing new-hire lab.
